definitions.lo, G, restore X, rho_r(X): as Amendment 3 (predictions_amend3.json), rho_r on the held-out windows
definitions.e_c: for alive subcomponent c of matrix k (rank-1 u_c v_c^T): mean over windows of ((x1 - x0) . v_c) * (g . u_c), x1 / x0 = k's trigger input in W1's / W0's pass, g = gradient of the window's trigger lo with respect to k's trigger output in W1's plain forward pass (no hooks); nats; positive = restoring c takes back gain. Training windows choose the sets; held-out windows give the reported e-hat only
definitions.D: per matrix k, the |S in k| alive pieces not in S with the largest training e_c (ties: index); short if fewer exist (recorded)
definitions.C_k: per matrix k, the |S in k| alive pieces not in S with the largest Delta_c (Amendment 4's definition; ties: index)
definitions.top-direction share of S: per matrix, S's members among the |S in k| alive pieces (S included) with the largest training e_c, summed over matrices, over |S|
definitions.e-hat(X): sum of held-out e_c over X, over G
